a folder of that name is already in the: 服務資料夾裡已經有這個名稱的資料夾
name must be lowercase letters, digits a: name 只能有小寫字母、數字和 -,2 到 48 個字元
url must be the repository's address: url 要是 repository 的位址
ref must be a tag or branch name, or nul: ref 要是 tag 或分支名稱，或 null
commit must be 40 hex characters: commit 要是 40 個十六進位字元
interface must be a whole number from 1: interface 要是從 1 起的整數
run must be {{cli, mcp, setup}}: command: run 要是 {{cli, mcp, setup}}:指令
granted.secrets must be a list of enviro: granted.secrets 要是環境變數名稱的清單
a registered project's former name: 已登錄專案以前的名稱
granted.{key} must be true or false: granted.{key} 要是 true 或 false
{path} is not a folder (a link or a file: {path} 不是資料夾(該是資料夾的地方是連結或檔案)
granted must be a mapping of models, sec: granted 要是 models、secrets、principal、network 的 mapping
follow must be tags or none: follow 要是 tags 或 none
tags must map release tags to commits: tags 要把 release tag 對應到 commit
previous must be 40 hex characters or nu: previous 要是 40 個十六進位字元或 null
secrets_required must list granted secre: secrets_required 只能列出已授權的 secret
{path} doesn't lead where it should: {path} 沒有指到它該在的地方
{name} is busy (another add, update, rem: {name} 正在忙(另一個 add、update、remove 或 run 拿著它)
